fieldNotes.pendingUpdates: Amendment 1.1.0. Inventory edits a reviewed amendment has recorded but not applied, each naming the open PR whose repair motivates it. reclassificationRule lets an artifact's record change only through an amendment that names the repairing PR, and a repair exists only once that PR is merged, so an entry here changes nothing: validators, gates, and #1408 read artifacts only. After the named PR merges, a write-back amendment (a PATCH version that records the PR's merge commit) applies the entry's changes to the artifact and removes the entry. If the PR closes unmerged or merges with a different repair, the write-back removes the entry without applying it, or a new amendment records the actual repair. openDefects is never edited: the write-back records each resolution beside it in defectResolutions {defect, resolvedByPr, scope}, so evidence rows still name a resolving PR per cutoff defect (E014).

artifacts.reason: Reclassified by contract amendment 1.4.0 (maintainer decision, 2026-10-08). Repaired by R2 PRs #1474 (merged 9ca52196baf0faedb91a947659c5e6a4c4966e30) and #1475 (merged 5ebdbee2fee7fc87d0db187ea81024c3aadcbc54) for #1410: nextjs-gh-pages.yml runs only by workflow_dispatch with an adjudication identity, rebuilds the site, and deploys only when its tree digest equals the adjudicated one. #1526 (merge 572e4ce049f598ccfbbb297e605de42af1778f9b) makes the build byte-reproducible (fixed build ID, path-independent module IDs, content-hashed entry scripts, sorted docs). #1424 builds it from the frozen candidate as an unpublished candidate (section 7). Its historical-only benchmark inputs are built in unchanged and establish no 0.24 claim. Cutoff reason: Deployed on release creation without any test or evidence gate; it publishes the stale benchmark surfaces.
